text:
In the echo of my deaths

there is still fear.

Do you know about fear?

I know about fear when I say my name.

It is fear,

fear with a black hat

hiding rats in my blood,

or fear with dead lips

drinking my desires.

Yes. In the echo of my deaths

there is still fear.

translation.title: Fear
translation.editorial_note: The repeated fear stays blunt, allowing the images to intensify around it.
